threat_event: Attacker takes over a contractor agent's mailbox and sends a buyer altered wire instructions; buyer wires closing funds to a criminal account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contractor agents have no MFA; legacy email protocols enabled; agents forward wire instructions by ordinary email; no alerts on forwarding rules
existing_controls: Wire fraud warning in contract packet and email footer; external-sender banner
treatment_plan: Enforce MFA for all contractor accounts and block legacy protocols; wire instructions delivered only through the Closing Communications Portal with a verbal callback script; forwarding-rule alerts

threat_event: Spoofed lender payoff letter or lien statement diverts an outgoing disbursement from the title escrow trust account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No callback for payoff and lien wires; payoff letters accepted by email; callback numbers sometimes taken from the same email
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02; SYS-08; title escrow trust account
existing_controls: Dual approval and hardware tokens on trust account wires
treatment_plan: Written disbursement verification procedure: payoff letters obtained directly from the lender portal or verified by callback to an independently sourced number; second approver checks the verification record

threat_event: Phishing with a credential-relay kit steals an employee session in Closing Services and the attacker reads closing files and plants inbox rules
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: App-based MFA can be relayed; no sign-in risk alerts; no mailbox audit review
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for Closing Services, Controller, and admins; sign-in risk alerts reviewed daily by the MSP

threat_event: Look-alike domain used to impersonate the closing team to buyers and sellers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DMARC at monitor only; no look-alike domain monitoring; clients not told which channel is authoritative
treatment_plan: Move DMARC to reject; register common look-alike domains; tell clients at contract that wire instructions come only through the portal

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts Main Office endpoints, the network storage device, and cloud workloads
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Signature antivirus only; no EDR; flat office network; storage device reachable from all endpoints
treatment_plan: MSP-managed EDR with 24x7 alerting; separate network for the storage device and servers

threat_event: Backups are deleted or encrypted along with production, and SaaS email and transaction data cannot be recovered
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup vault in the same cloud account with the same admins; no independent SaaS backup; never restore-tested
existing_controls: Daily backups; SaaS vendors' own backups
treatment_plan: Separate backup account with immutable retention; third-party backup of email and transaction data; quarterly restore test

threat_event: A departing contractor agent keeps access and takes client files to a competing brokerage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contractor accounts disabled up to 14 days after departure; no access reviews
existing_controls: Sales Managers email IT when an agent leaves
treatment_plan: Same-day disable when the agent's license transfer is noticed; weekly reconciliation against the state license roster; quarterly access review

threat_event: Loss or theft of a contractor agent's personal laptop or phone with cached contracts, IDs, and wire instructions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Personal devices unmanaged; no minimum device standard; no remote wipe of company data
treatment_plan: Mobile application management for email and the transaction app (app-level wipe, no local storage of attachments); device standard in the agent agreement

threat_event: Attacker exploits a flaw in the Closing Communications Portal to read closing documents or change displayed wire instructions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Custom app built without secure development standards; never tested; no web application firewall
existing_controls: Portal requires emailed one-time code to sign in
treatment_plan: Application penetration test before 2026-11-15; fix critical and high findings; secure development standard for the contract developer

threat_event: Unpatched firewall or VPN appliance exploited to enter the office network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No vulnerability scanning; firmware updated ad hoc by the MSP
treatment_plan: Quarterly firmware updates; monthly authenticated vulnerability scans with remediation deadlines

threat_event: Theft of or unauthorized access to the unencrypted network storage device holding 2016-2022 scanned closing files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Device unencrypted; in an open office area; shared credentials
treatment_plan: Apply the retention schedule; move retained files to encrypted cloud storage; destroy the device with a certificate

threat_event: Unauthorized person reads or removes paper closing files from the unlocked storage room at the Branch Office
threat_source: Visitor, cleaning crew, or former contractor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Storage room unlocked; files kept indefinitely
treatment_plan: Lock the room with a key log; scan and destroy files older than the retention period

threat_event: A service provider (tenant screening, transaction platform, or MSP) is breached and exposes customer information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No service provider inventory; most contracts lack security terms; SOC reports never reviewed
existing_controls: Vendors chosen on features and price
treatment_plan: Service provider inventory; security terms at renewal; annual SOC report review (started in P09)

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP's remote management tool gives an attacker control of every company endpoint
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP tool access not restricted by source IP; MSP technicians share one admin account
treatment_plan: Named MSP accounts with phishing-resistant MFA and source restrictions; annual MSP security review

threat_event: A Closing Services employee changes a payee in the disbursement ledger to divert funds
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Ledger changes after balancing are not logged for review
existing_controls: Dual approval of wires; monthly three-way reconciliation
treatment_plan: Weekly review of post-balance payee changes by the Controller

threat_event: A closing package with Social Security numbers and bank details is emailed to the wrong recipient
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Email autocomplete; closing documents sent as unencrypted attachments
treatment_plan: Send closing documents only through the portal; enforced encryption rule for emails containing Social Security or account numbers

threat_event: The company misses the FTC or Florida notification deadline after a notification event
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written incident response plan; no breach determination procedure
treatment_plan: Adopt POL-03 and the P08 runbook; annual tabletop exercise

threat_event: Password spraying against contractor accounts yields bulk download of transaction files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MFA for contractors; legacy protocols; no download alerts
treatment_plan: Covered by the R-001 MFA rollout; bulk download alerts in the transaction platform

threat_event: Customer information kept long past its business need is exposed in a breach, raising notice counts and harm
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No retention schedule; files kept indefinitely (314.4(c)(6))
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-02; SYS-06 storage device; paper files
treatment_plan: Retention schedule honoring the two-year disposal rule and Florida record-keeping duties; annual purge

threat_event: Transaction management platform outage during a peak closing week
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single platform; no offline copy of active transaction files
treatment_plan: Weekly export of active transaction files to the backup vault; downtime procedure

threat_event: Internet outage at the Main Office on a closing day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single internet provider at the Main Office
existing_controls: Staff can release wires from the bank app on a hotspot
treatment_plan: Accepted: closings can continue on cellular hotspots; review at next ISP contract renewal

threat_event: Hurricane closes the Main Office for several days during active closings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: All closing staff and the storage device at one site
treatment_plan: Hurricane plan: remote closing procedure, pre-staged laptops, and client notices; test each June

threat_event: Tenant screening recommendations produce unjustified disparate denials by race, national origin, disability, or familial status
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recommendation used as the decision in practice; criteria never validated; no disparity testing
treatment_plan: Written screening criteria; individualized review before any denial; quarterly disparity testing (P10)

threat_event: Buyer lead scoring gives slower or lesser service to buyers from certain ZIP codes or language groups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Score inputs include ZIP code and inquiry language; never tested
existing_controls: Every lead gets a same-day response by policy
treatment_plan: Remove ZIP code and language inputs; monthly response-time parity check (P10)

threat_event: An applicant is denied based on a consumer report without the required adverse action notice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notice generated by the platform only when the decline button is used, not for conditional approvals
treatment_plan: Adverse action notice for conditional approvals (higher deposit) as well as declines; monthly sample

threat_event: Staff paste client financial details into a public generative AI tool
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No approved-tools list; no AI rule in policy
treatment_plan: POL-05 approved-tools rule; enterprise AI tool with no-training terms

threat_event: Fraudulent request changes a property owner's payout bank account and diverts rent distributions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Owner bank changes accepted by email without callback
existing_controls: Owner portal requires sign-in for some changes
treatment_plan: Owner bank changes only in the owner portal with MFA, plus callback to the number on file and a 5-day hold

threat_event: An escrow shortage in the sales or property management escrow account goes undetected for weeks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Reconciliations are monthly
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 475.25(1)(k); Fla. Admin. Code r. 61J2-14.012
treatment_plan: Accepted: monthly reconciliation meets r. 61J2-14.012(2); daily bank alerts on outgoing wires cover the gap

threat_event: An untested change to the integration service shows the wrong wire instructions in the portal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No change management procedure; changes deployed directly by the contract developer
treatment_plan: Change procedure with test and approval; wire instructions in the portal locked after verification

threat_event: A compromised personal device on the staff Wi-Fi spreads malware to company endpoints
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contractor agents' personal devices join the staff Wi-Fi
existing_controls: Guest Wi-Fi exists but is not enforced
treatment_plan: Personal devices only on guest Wi-Fi; staff Wi-Fi by certificate

threat_event: Spoofed seller email asks that sale proceeds go to a new account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Some sellers are out of state and communicate only by email
existing_controls: Callback to the number collected at listing; dual approval
treatment_plan: Keep the callback control; add it to the written procedure and sample it monthly

threat_event: Contractor agent mailboxes auto-forward transaction email to personal webmail accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Auto-forwarding to external domains allowed; five active rules found in P07
treatment_plan: Block external auto-forwarding; remove the five rules; alert on new rules

threat_event: Stolen online banking session of an escrow account user sends an unauthorized wire from the sales or property management escrow account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single approver for wires from these two accounts
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-08; sales and property management escrow accounts
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 475.25(1)(k); Fla. Admin. Code r. 61J2-14.010
existing_controls: Hardware token; positive pay on checks
treatment_plan: Dual approval for all escrow account wires (bank setting)

threat_event: An impostor poses as the owner of a vacant lot or rental home, lists it, and receives the sale proceeds
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remote sellers verified only by documents returned by mail or email
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-02; title escrow trust account
treatment_plan: Enhanced identity verification for remote and vacant-property sellers (knowledge checks against public records, video meeting, and title history review)
